title: pos_cash.statement_issued (POS_PARTNER)
description: One event = one row of POS_CASH_balance.csv (original column names and values are kept in payload). event_time: 02:00 on day 1 of the month after MONTHS_BALANCE (counted from the submission month).

event_id.description: BLAKE2b-128 of source_table + natural key. Deterministic -> use it for de-duplication.

schema_version.description: SemVer. A MAJOR change -> new topic (.v2).

event_time.description: Business time (simulated, +07:00). 02:00 on day 1 of the month after MONTHS_BALANCE (counted from the submission month).

produced_at.description: Wall-clock time the producer sent the event.

customer_id.description: SK_ID_CURR of the customer; also the Kafka message key.

SK_ID_CURR.description: ID of loan in our sample

MONTHS_BALANCE.description: Month of balance relative to application date (-1 means the information to the freshest monthly snapshot, 0 means the information at application - often it will be the same as -1 as many banks are not updating the information to Credit Bureau regularly )
MONTHS_BALANCE.x-note: time only relative to the application

CNT_INSTALMENT.description: Term of previous credit (can change over time)

CNT_INSTALMENT_FUTURE.description: Installments left to pay on the previous credit

SK_DPD.description: DPD (days past due) during the month of previous credit

SK_DPD_DEF.description: DPD during the month with tolerance (debts with low loan amounts are ignored) of the previous credit
